Vulnerabilities.Title: Babel vulnerable to arbitrary code execution when compiling specific code
Vulnerabilities.Description: Babel is a compiler for writing next generation JavaScript. Using internal Babel plugins can trigger code execution.

Vulnerabilities.Title: HTTP/2 Rapid Reset vulnerability
Vulnerabilities.Description: The HTTP/2 protocol allows a denial of service (server resource consumption) via HEADERS frames.

Vulnerabilities.Title: cookie regular expression denial of service
Vulnerabilities.Description: An issue in cookie allows a remote attacker to cause a denial of service.
